name: Ray's Mod
desc:
v5.7
-Added 8 new addons
-Added 6 new community maps
-Added 6 new missions
-Updated the Mech addon
-Added a 50% off gamepass for Mission Point addons
-Added addon testing for Mission Point addons
-Added daily Mission Point rewards with special day 7 addons (each month on day 7 you get a new addon only for that month)
-Some patches on Save n Load

[PHYSICS GUN CONTROLS]
LEFT CLICK- grab object
RIGHT CLICK /G - freeze object
C/Scroll up - move object further
X- move object closer
E- straighten object
R- rotate object

Ray's Mod is a remake of Garry's mod (aka Gmod). You can make a base out of props, drive, spawn enemies, play gamemodes, play with friends and just do whatever you want! (VR planned on being reworked)

Check out my old version: https://www.roblox.com/games/160207495/Garrys-Mod
